description: An availability check with Google Pay options. Android builds its availability launcher from them; iOS asks the device about Apple Pay and takes no options.

parityGaps.result: D8: iOS answers from StripeAPI.deviceSupportsApplePay() at once; Android answers after Google Pay's ready check, which needs a device.
parityGaps.googlePayLauncher.isTestEnv: D8: Only Android reads the googlePay options.
